_comment: RECORDED top-k retrieval output of the RAG system under test (the 'good' run), k=3. For each question id, the ordered list of doc-chunk ids the retriever returned. In real use these come from running your Module-04 RAG retriever over data/rag-heldout.json; committed here as a deterministic fixture so eval runs offline. This run retrieves a relevant doc in the top-3 for 11 of 12 questions; it misses Q11 (returns plausible-but-wrong chunks) -> retrieval@3 = 0.917.
